newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady except firmer gasoline.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady except firmer gasoline.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Wednesday morning, except gasoline which firmed on continued tightness in the ARA region, dealers said.
Gasoline gained $1/$2 a tonne, prompt eurograde offered at $196.50 fob Rotterdam. Swaps were up by around $2, leaving August at around $191 fob ARA.
Heating oil barges were steady as IPE August gas oil futures added about 50 cents, but premiums backed down. Prompt deliveries were offered at IPE August +50 cents fob Rotterdam.

Antwerp offers were below screen level. Offers for first half August loadings were at around +75 cents fob Rotterdam. German buyers were further discouraged by another sharp rise of the dollar against the mark.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were little changed from Tuesday's close when prices rose as many traders covered shorts. A couple of prompt trades were concluded at $90 fob Rotterdam, to a single ARA trading house.
Early bunker enquiries amounted to little more than 10,000 tonnes. -- Philip Blenkinsop, Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5004
